scheme_name: Scheme for Financial Assistance in Case of Death
other_conditions: Applicant must be a nominee, spouse, or dependent of the deceased registered worker
The registered construction worker must have no dues payable to the Board
Application must be submitted within one year of the death
If the registered beneficiary is covered under the Group Life Insurance scheme taken by the Board, the death benefit under this scheme does not apply
benefits_summary: One-time grant of ₹2,00,000 for natural death or ₹4,00,000 for accidental death during employment.
